name: blanc-tab-import
description: Create a private, one-time handoff from one supported browser window to Blanc.

interface.shortDescription: Copy one browser window into a new Blanc window.
interface.longDescription: Copies URL, title, order, and active-tab status from one supported Chromium-family browser window into an expiring, one-time Blanc handoff. Source tabs remain untouched.
defaultPrompt: Open this browser window in Blanc.
Copy my selected tabs into Blanc.
Create a Blanc handoff for these tabs.
